market_prices.notes: Prices are the last completed trading day's close, not real-time intraday — Alpha Vantage's free tier is delayed to the prior close. LSE ETF prices are in GBP (CSP1.LON is quoted by Alpha Vantage in GBX/pence, converted here to whole pounds). USD holdings (GIA) are converted to GBP using Alpha Vantage's own live USD/GBP rate. Argo Blockchain, the Vanguard FTSE Global All Cap fund and SpaceX are not covered (no listed real-time quote available for these).
